abilities.name: THREADING
abilities.description: Counter pressure shrinks the opponent's decision window by 80%.
abilities.detail: Threading is a timing tool, not a damage tool. It buys the quarter second that turns a losing exchange into a clean exit.

abilities.name: OVERCLOCK
abilities.description: Raises drive output 40% for six seconds, then cooks the heat sink.
abilities.detail: The crawler will outrun anything on the flats and then need a repair bay. Overclock is a route tool for people who planned the exit.

abilities.name: THERMAL SHIELD
abilities.description: Wraps the chassis in a heat envelope rated for storm crossing.
abilities.detail: Standard issue for survey crews. The shield does not make the crawler fast; it makes the storm survivable.

abilities.name: ION DRILL
abilities.description: Cuts an extraction shaft through the ice shelf.
abilities.detail: Ion drills are slow and cheap and every crew owns one. The guild buys ice by the tonne.

abilities.name: DRONE SWEEP
abilities.description: Launches a survey ring that marks intel objects in a 400 m radius.
abilities.detail: The sweep does not reveal everything. It reveals what the drone can see, which is usually enough to choose a direction.

abilities.name: SIGNAL JAM
abilities.description: Scrambles hostile tracking for four seconds.
abilities.detail: Jamming is a blunt instrument. It also breaks the crawler's own nav feed for the same four seconds.

abilities.name: AEGIS PLATE
abilities.description: Deploys a hardlight plate across the forward chassis arc.
abilities.detail: Cartel manufacture. The plate eats a rail hit and the crawler keeps its nose. The heat sink notices.

abilities.name: RECON PING
abilities.description: Sends a pulse that echoes off viable cargo.
abilities.detail: Cheap, quiet and useful. Every pad runner leaves one installed unless a bigger ability needs the slot.

abilities.name: THRUSTER BLOOM
abilities.description: Vents the rear diffuser for a short hop over broken ground.
abilities.detail: A bloom is not flight. It clears the washboard and lands hard, and the suspension fee is real.

abilities.name: HARDLIGHT CUT
abilities.description: A sustained cutting beam for salvage and forced entry.
abilities.detail: Hellforge manufacture. Cuts rover frames in half; lights the basalt on fire if the operator is careless.
